caption:
Numbers on screen or eating without counting? Comment A or B.

In WE.LIFE you pick a mode. Fit & shape shows how many kcal you have left today, with protein, carbs and fats next to it. Everyday is a meal plan and shopping without numbers. You can switch later.

WE.LIFE is a Life OS for everyday life, and Food OS is its first module. Your account is free. The link to WE.LIFE is in our bio @welife.world.

The images are AI-generated illustrations.
